items.prompt: Why can a deterministic matcher pass conservation tests and still overstate a historical strategy's fills?
items.modelAnswer: Conservation checks internal quantity accounting under declared input/priority. They do not establish that the book at order arrival was known/complete or that queue,delay,hidden liquidity,cancellations,impact,fees and availability were modeled faithfully. Need documented source/time/venue assumptions and sensitivity scenarios;no universal real-fill prediction.

criteria.text: Separates internal correctness from external realism.
